manifest.source: Controlled census of the installed darwin-arm64 Grok 1.0.0 artifact. The public xai-org/grok-build mirror is supplemental because it does not contain the binary-reported revision; see findings.md.

argv.notes: The native composition is one long-lived leader plus a leader-attached ACP controller and TUI.

acp.notes: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 NDJSON over stdio. Standard session/update and xAI extension methods are separate observable rails.

session-log.notes: Append-only GROK_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/updates.jsonl records with timestamp, method, and params.

session-state.notes: Replace-in-place signals.json and summary.json beside updates.jsonl.

leader.notes: Coordination socket owned by grok agent leader; it is topology, not a normalized semantic event source.

terminal.notes: Native leader-attached TUI. Semantics are derived from ACP and persisted files, never terminal text.

claims.harness: controlled ACP, PTY, leader, and native-store census documented in packages/surface/vendors/grok/findings.md

claims.notes: Source-only lead from a public mirror whose revision is not the installed artifact's binary-reported revision. It cannot promote an artifact claim.

limitations: The exact binary-reported source revision is absent from the public source mirror, so source-to-artifact equivalence is unverified and this candidate is not promoted in support/agents.json.
Compaction, subagent, workflow, and goal lifecycle names are source-backed but were not forced in the installed-artifact census; their behavior nodes remain unverified.
Only darwin-arm64 has artifact integrity and controlled-census evidence for this candidate.

events.notes: Installed-artifact spelling for live xAI extensions; do not conflate it with the persisted _x.ai/session/update method.
ACP-standard cancellation implemented by the adapter path but not exercised in the installed-artifact census.
Advertised by the installed artifact and required by the adapter resume path; a resumed turn was not included in the controlled capture.
ACP-standard request implemented by the installed client/agent stack but not exercised in the minimal artifact census.
Observed both live over ACP and durably in updates.jsonl; channel is the default trigger rail and channels records both native observations.

behavior.title: Grok 1.0.0 native ACP and durable-session lifecycle
behavior.description: A partial order over Grok's real rails. Shared methods are distinguished by update.sessionUpdate and nested native fields such as event_name; live ACP, append-only updates, state files, and leader topology are not collapsed into normalized agent states.
behavior.source: Installed-artifact controlled census. Compact/subagent/workflow names are supplemental public-source evidence and remain unverified because the binary revision is not published in the mirror.
